checks.text: Selecting "What is X% of Y?" in the mode selector, typing "20" in the field labelled "Percent" and "50" in the field labelled "Value", then clicking "Calculate" shows "10" in the result summary.
Selecting "What percent is X of Y?" in the mode selector, typing "10" in the field labelled "Part" and "50" in the field labelled "Whole", then clicking "Calculate" shows "20%" in the result summary.
Selecting "Increase by X%" in the mode selector, typing "15" in the field labelled "Percent" and "100" in the field labelled "Original", then clicking "Calculate" shows "115" in the result summary.
Selecting "Decrease by X%" in the mode selector, typing "10" in the field labelled "Percent" and "200" in the field labelled "Original", then clicking "Calculate" shows "180" in the result summary.
After performing a calculation, clicking the "Copy result" button copies the exact result text to the clipboard.
Clicking the "History" tab shows a list of previous calculations; the most recent entry contains the mode name and the result value.
Clicking the "Delete" button next to a history entry removes that entry from the list.
Reload keeps the history list; after reloading, the previously calculated entry is still visible in the History tab.
